description: Phase-MM Wave 1.5 — Audio sidecar substrate. 3 stories that prepare the docker compose stack for Wave 2 (audio IN) and Wave 3 (audio OUT) WITHOUT touching Go agent code yet. Pattern: extend the Wave 2.10 init-models bootstrap with two new model artifacts (Whisper baseline GGML + Piper Paola medium ONNX), then add two sidecars (aura-whisper, aura-piper) following the established markitdown-mcp shape (read_only + tmpfs + cap_drop ALL + no-new-privileges + 2 CPU / 1G memory limits). Spike-validated 2026-05-19: Whisper baseline GGML small + Piper Paola medium IT cleared latency + footprint + Italian quality bars (see docs/phase-mm-audio-spike-2026-05-19.md for measurements, sidecar topology diagram, and HTTP shape proposals). Order is strict: INIT00 (model fetch) MUST land before INIT01/INIT02 — both sidecars start with depends_on aura-init-models:service_completed_successfully. NO Go agent code is touched in this wave — that's Wave 2 (US-MM-A01..A04). After all 3 close, next queue is Phase-MM Wave 2 (audio IN: InboundMessage.Attachments + whisper transcription pipeline + probe coverage). Master HEAD at queue creation: 47402683. STRICT one-story-exit per Ralph CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: Extend aura-init-models to fetch Whisper GGML + Piper Paola ONNX/JSON
userStories.description: Add two new model artifacts to the Wave 2.10 init bootstrap. The existing pattern lives in internal/install/embedding.go (constants + EnsureEmbeddingModel) and cmd/aura-init-models/main.go (sequential ensure-calls). Replicate the same shape for Whisper baseline and Piper Paola voice: (a) internal/install/whisper.go exposing WhisperModelFilename/URL/SHA256/Size + EnsureWhisperModel(ctx, dataDir, progress) error; (b) internal/install/piper.go exposing PiperVoiceFilename + PiperVoiceConfigFilename + their URL/SHA256 constants + EnsurePiperVoice(ctx, dataDir, progress) that downloads BOTH files (ONNX + sidecar JSON) into dataDir/piper/. Voice files MUST land under dataDir/piper/ subdir (matching the spike-doc topology: ./data/piper:/voices:ro in aura-piper compose mount). Whisper file lands flat at dataDir/ggml-small.bin (matching embedding precedent: dataDir/embeddinggemma-300m-Q4_0.gguf). Operator override envs: AURA_WHISPER_MODEL_URL, AURA_WHISPER_MODEL_SHA256, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_URL, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_SHA256, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_CFG_URL, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_CFG_SHA256. Same env-or-default helper from embedding.go (reuse envOrDefault if accessible, or duplicate it locally — file is internal pkg-private). Wire ensure-calls into cmd/aura-init-models/main.go in sequence after EnsureEmbeddingModel: EnsureWhisperModel then EnsurePiperVoice. On any error, log + exit 1 (existing pattern). Also extend docker compose service `aura-init-models` env block with the 6 new operator-override env vars (pattern matches existing AURA_EMBEDDING_MODEL_URL / SHA256 lines).
acceptanceCriteria: internal/install/whisper.go created with WhisperModelFilename="ggml-small.bin", WhisperModelURL pointing to https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-small.bin, WhisperModelSHA256 = lowercase-hex SHA-256 (compute via curl + sha256sum during implementation, pin in code, add rotation-procedure comment matching embedding.go style), and EnsureWhisperModel(ctx, dataDir, progress ProgressFn) error

internal/install/piper.go created with PiperVoiceFilename="it_IT-paola-medium.onnx", PiperVoiceConfigFilename="it_IT-paola-medium.onnx.json", URLs from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/it/it_IT/paola/medium/{filename}, SHA-256 pinned for both, and EnsurePiperVoice(ctx, dataDir, progress) that downloads ONNX + JSON into dataDir/piper/ (creating the subdir via EnsureParentDir on each target)
Both new ensure-functions use the existing install.Download + install.DownloadOpts machinery (NO new HTTP code; reuse the SHA-256 + atomic-rename + retry path)

Operator-override envs honored: AURA_WHISPER_MODEL_URL, AURA_WHISPER_MODEL_SHA256, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_URL, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_SHA256, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_CFG_URL, AURA_PIPER_VOICE_CFG_SHA256 — empty value falls back to the pinned constant (mirror embedding.go envOrDefault pattern)

internal/install/whisper_test.go + piper_test.go cover at minimum: cache-hit path (file already present with matching SHA), corrupt-file path (file present but SHA mismatch triggers re-download), and env-override path (envOrDefault picks env value when set). userStories.notes: GROUND-TRUTH BEFORE EDIT: read internal/install/embedding.go AND internal/install/download.go AND cmd/aura-init-models/main.go fully. The 80% of the work is already in the embedding pattern — this story is a faithful copy-paste-adapt for two more files. Do NOT invent a new downloader, do NOT skip the SHA-256 pinning step (the whole point of the Wave 2.10 bootstrap is integrity verification — see commit eb7e61ad / memory project_wave_2_10_install_bootstrap_shipped). To compute SHA-256 in implementation: `curl -L -o /tmp/ggml-small.bin <url> && sha256sum /tmp/ggml-small.bin` then paste lowercase hex into the constant. Repeat for the two Piper files. Document fetch-date in the rotation-procedure comment block (match embedding.go style — comment says when the SHA was verified). DO NOT touch docker/init-models/Dockerfile — it just builds the Go binary; the new logic is in the Go pkg + compose env. DO NOT add a new sidecar service in this story — that's INIT01/INIT02. Scope discipline: this story ONLY touches Go code under internal/install/ + cmd/aura-init-models/ + compose.yaml env block for aura-init-models. NOT compose.yaml service list, NOT docker/ subdirs.

userStories.title: Add aura-whisper sidecar to compose.yaml (whisper.cpp HTTP server)
userStories.description: Add a new long-lived sidecar service `aura-whisper` that wraps whisper.cpp's upstream whisper-server binary. The sidecar loads ggml-small.bin once at startup (amortizes the ~670 ms model load cost the spike measured) and serves HTTP transcription requests. Use the markitdown-mcp pattern (compose.yaml aura-markitdown is the template) for hardening: read_only fs, tmpfs /tmp 256m, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, deploy.resources.limits cpus=2.0 memory=1G. Build context: new directory docker/whisper/ with a Dockerfile that (a) starts from a slim debian base, (b) installs git + build-essential + cmake + libssl-dev, (c) clones ggerganov/whisper.cpp at a pinned tag (release v1.8.4 or newer per memory reference_whisper_cpp_binary_path), (d) builds via CMake — binaries land at /opt/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-server NOT /opt/whisper.cpp/main, (e) drops to a non-root user, (f) exposes 8082, (g) ENTRYPOINT is whisper-server with --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8082 -m /models/ggml-small.bin -t 4 (4 threads matches spike + minipc-cpu-budget memory). The whisper-server upstream exposes POST /inference (multipart audio_file) returning JSON. We do NOT rewrap to /v1/transcribe in this story — that adapter is Wave 2 (Go client side decides what shape it talks to). Service in compose.yaml: name aura-whisper, image aura-whisper:local, build context docker/whisper/, mount ./data:/models:ro to read ggml-small.bin (placed there by aura-init-models US-MM-INIT00), host port mapping 127.0.0.1:8082:8082 (loopback-only — sidecar is reachable from aura container via docker bridge), depends_on aura-init-models:service_completed_successfully, restart unless-stopped. Healthcheck: curl -fsS http://localhost:8082/ returning 200 within 30s (whisper-server has a built-in GET / that returns the upload form HTML — adequate liveness signal; if curl is missing on the slim base, install it or use wget). Aura main container env: ADD `WHISPER_BASE_URL: "http://aura-whisper:8082"` to the aura service environment block — env will be inert until Wave 2 wires the Go client. Do NOT add aura.depends_on for aura-whisper (graceful degradation pattern from qdrant — sidecar failure does not block aura boot).
acceptanceCriteria: docker/whisper/Dockerfile created. Multi-stage OR single-stage acceptable; final image MUST drop to non-root (e.g. UID 65532 or `nobody:nogroup`) and contain only the whisper-server binary + minimal runtime deps (no torch, no python — pure C++ binary from whisper.cpp CMake build). Final image size <1 GB target

compose.yaml gains a new service `aura-whisper` with: build.context=docker/whisper/, image=aura-whisper:local, restart=unless-stopped, ports=127.0.0.1:8082:8082, volumes=./data:/models:ro, depends_on.aura-init-models.condition=service_completed_successfully, healthcheck against localhost:8082, read_only=true, tmpfs=/tmp:size=256m, cap_drop=[ALL], security_opt=[no-new-privileges:true], deploy.resources.limits.cpus=2.0 + memory=1G

ENTRYPOINT or command launches whisper-server with --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8082 -m /models/ggml-small.bin -t 4 (or via shell wrapper if upstream binary requires it). Threads=4 is hard requirement per memory feedback_minipc_cpu_budget
compose.yaml aura.environment gains a new line: WHISPER_BASE_URL: "http://aura-whisper:8082" — placed alphabetically near the existing model-URL settings
compose.yaml aura.depends_on does NOT gain aura-whisper (graceful degradation — sidecar failure should not block aura boot)

Manual smoke documented in commit message: `docker compose build aura-whisper && docker compose up -d aura-whisper && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8082/` returns whisper-server HTML index page within 30s of startup. Then send a sample audio: `curl -F 'file=@samples-in/sample.wav' http://127.0.0.1:8082/inference -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data'` returns a JSON transcript. (Spike WAVs at D:/tmp/audio-spike/samples-in/ are usable if available; if not, generate a 1s silence WAV with ffmpeg.)
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green — no Go code changes in this story, this validates that compose.yaml YAML stays parseable + nothing else regressed
`docker compose config` exits 0 (validates compose schema)
Single atomic commit prefix: feat(compose): aura-whisper sidecar with whisper.cpp baseline model (US-MM-INIT01)
userStories.notes: GROUND-TRUTH BEFORE EDIT: read compose.yaml in full to internalize the markitdown service shape (lines 251-277). Also read docker/markitdown/Dockerfile as the template style. Memory reference_whisper_cpp_binary_path is load-bearing: modern whisper.cpp (v1.8.4+) builds via CMake; binaries are at build/bin/, NOT a legacy /opt/whisper.cpp/main location. The upstream binary is `whisper-server` (with a hyphen), NOT `whisper_server`. The spike doc (docs/phase-mm-audio-spike-2026-05-19.md, sidecar topology + HTTP shapes section) is the design reference. DO NOT write a Python HTTP wrapper — use the upstream whisper-server binary directly. Aura's Go client (Wave 2) will adapt to whisper-server's native /inference shape. The host-side port 8082 is loopback-only per defense-in-depth: only aura (via docker network) reaches the sidecar in production. SCOPE: this story DOES NOT touch Go code (no Wave 2 wiring), does NOT add a Python wrapper, does NOT rewrap the HTTP shape. It ONLY adds the build context, the compose service, and the inert WHISPER_BASE_URL env on aura. ANTIPATTERN GUARD: if you find yourself writing internal/whisper/ or internal/audio/ code, STOP — that's Wave 2. Stay in docker/whisper/ + compose.yaml only. Image size target <1G is a soft target — final whisper.cpp build is ~50 MB binary + ggml-small.bin already on the mounted volume (not in the image). Use multi-stage build to keep the final image lean (build-stage has cmake/g++; runtime-stage has just the binary + libgomp1 / libstdc++6).

userStories.title: Add aura-piper sidecar to compose.yaml (Piper TTS HTTP server, default OFF)
userStories.description: Add a new long-lived sidecar service `aura-piper` that wraps rhasspy/piper for Italian TTS. The sidecar loads it_IT-paola-medium.onnx once at startup (amortizes the ~670 ms model load cost the spike measured) and serves HTTP synthesis requests. Piper upstream does NOT ship a built-in HTTP server — write a thin Python wrapper using either (a) the official piper-tts PyPI package which exposes PiperVoice.load() + voice.synthesize_stream_raw() returning PCM bytes, OR (b) shell out to the piper binary per request (slower; cold-start avoided since process stays warm). Recommended: option (a) — FastAPI + uvicorn (or stdlib http.server if you want zero deps beyond piper-tts) loading voice once at module init and serving POST /v1/synthesize with JSON body {"text":"...","voice":"it_IT-paola-medium"} returning audio/wav (22 kHz mono PCM s16le, framed via stdlib `wave` module since piper returns raw PCM). Headers: X-Duration-S + X-Elapsed-Ms for telemetry. GET /health returns 200 once voice is loaded. Use the markitdown-mcp pattern for hardening (read_only, tmpfs /tmp, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, deploy.resources.limits cpus=2.0 memory=1G — spike measured ~150 MB post-load, 1G is generous). Build context: new directory docker/piper/ with a Dockerfile (python:3.11-slim-bookworm or 3.13-slim — pick the one with current piper-tts wheel support; spike used 3.11), pip install piper-tts (NO torch — piper-tts ships ONNX runtime under the hood; if pip install pulls torch as a transitive, override with --no-deps + pin explicit deps, or use --index-url for CPU-only). Service in compose.yaml: name aura-piper, image aura-piper:local, build context docker/piper/, mount ./data/piper:/voices:ro (matches US-MM-INIT00 storage layout — voice files placed there by init-models), host port 127.0.0.1:8083:8083 (loopback-only), depends_on aura-init-models:service_completed_successfully, restart unless-stopped. Aura main container env: ADD `PIPER_BASE_URL: "http://aura-piper:8083"` and `AURA_TTS_ENABLED: "${AURA_TTS_ENABLED:-false}"` (default OFF per spike + memory phase-mm-audio-models — TTS is operator-toggled, never auto-triggered) to the aura service environment block. Env will be inert until Wave 3 wires the Go speak_reply tool. Do NOT add aura.depends_on for aura-piper (graceful degradation).
acceptanceCriteria: docker/piper/Dockerfile created. Slim Python base (3.11 or 3.13), pip install piper-tts (verify the wheel exists on PyPI at story implementation time — if upstream renamed the package, pin to whatever the current PyPI name is), drops to non-root user, exposes 8083

docker/piper/server.py (or similar) — thin Python HTTP server that loads PiperVoice.load("/voices/it_IT-paola-medium.onnx") once at startup and serves POST /v1/synthesize + GET /health. JSON-in, audio/wav-out. Framing raw PCM into a WAV is done via stdlib `wave` module. NO ML framework imports beyond piper-tts itself — keep the image lean

Image MUST NOT contain torch or large CUDA libs. Verify with `docker image inspect aura-piper:local --format='{{.Size}}'` — final image size <500 MB target (Piper ONNX runtime is small; only piper-tts + onnxruntime + fastapi/uvicorn + libgomp). Pin pip --index-url to CPU-only if torch sneaks in as a transitive (memory feedback_pip_torch_cuda_default_on_linux)

compose.yaml gains a new service `aura-piper` with: build.context=docker/piper/, image=aura-piper:local, restart=unless-stopped, ports=127.0.0.1:8083:8083, volumes=./data/piper:/voices:ro, depends_on.aura-init-models.condition=service_completed_successfully, healthcheck against localhost:8083/health, read_only=true, tmpfs=/tmp:size=256m, cap_drop=[ALL], security_opt=[no-new-privileges:true], deploy.resources.limits.cpus=2.0 + memory=1G

compose.yaml aura.environment gains TWO new lines: PIPER_BASE_URL: "http://aura-piper:8083" and AURA_TTS_ENABLED: "${AURA_TTS_ENABLED:-false}" (default OFF — operator must explicitly set AURA_TTS_ENABLED=true to opt in)
compose.yaml aura.depends_on does NOT gain aura-piper (graceful degradation)

Manual smoke documented in commit message: `docker compose build aura-piper && docker compose up -d aura-piper && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8083/health` returns 200 with `{"ok":true}` (or equivalent). Then `curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"Ciao Aura, sei collegata?"}' http://127.0.0.1:8083/v1/synthesize -o /tmp/test.wav` produces a non-empty audio/wav file. Optional: `ffprobe /tmp/test.wav` confirms 22050 Hz mono PCM s16le
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green — no Go code changes in this story; validates compose.yaml stays parseable + nothing else regressed
`docker compose config` exits 0

userStories.notes: GROUND-TRUTH BEFORE EDIT: read compose.yaml in full and docker/markitdown/Dockerfile as the slim-Python template. Memory feedback_pip_torch_cuda_default_on_linux is LOAD-BEARING: pip install on Linux defaults to pulling CUDA torch wheels (~1.5 GB) — piper-tts internally uses onnxruntime, not torch, but a transitive dep might still grab torch. Verify with `docker run --rm aura-piper:local pip list | grep -i torch` after build — should be empty. If torch sneaks in, add explicit deps + --no-deps to the pip install, or pin --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu as a defense. The spike doc (docs/phase-mm-audio-spike-2026-05-19.md) section 'Piper TTS — Paola medium voice' is the design reference for HTTP shape + framing the raw PCM into WAV. The default-OFF gate is a strong product requirement (memory reference_phase_mm_audio_models_2026-05-18 + the spike doc 'operator-toggled OFF by default') — do NOT default AURA_TTS_ENABLED to true. SCOPE: this story DOES NOT touch Go code (no Wave 3 speak_reply tool — that's a later story). It ONLY adds the build context, the compose service, the Python HTTP wrapper, and the inert PIPER_BASE_URL + AURA_TTS_ENABLED env on aura. ANTIPATTERN GUARD: if you find yourself writing internal/piper/ or internal/agent/tools/registry/files_audio.go, STOP — that's Wave 3. Stay in docker/piper/ + compose.yaml only. Giorgio voice + multi-voice routing are DEFERRED per spike doc (HF flagged 3 suspicious files in kirys79/piper_italiano repo) — Paola only. The HTTP shape (POST /v1/synthesize, JSON in, audio/wav out) is the contract Wave 3 Go code will speak to — keep it stable; do NOT introduce a streaming WebSocket variant in this story. Storage layout: voice files live under ./data/piper/ subdir (US-MM-INIT00 places them there). The compose mount is ./data/piper:/voices:ro and the server.py loads from /voices/it_IT-paola-medium.onnx.
